page_topic_one_liner: Alignify homepage — growth is a research loop; playbook from 100+ AI products for teams that refuse to be silent
differentiator_vs_generic: Brand hero about the growth research loop, NOT a generic SaaS landing or channel index. HERO must show a circular research flywheel (observe → hypothesize → ship → measure) with chapter motifs from the homepage narrative.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Growth research loop diagram — four nodes in a circular arrow flywheel (Problem / Shift / Levers / Receipts) with klein-blue accent connectors and blurred metric ticks
Secondary: stacked chapter index cards (01–05) peeling like torn paper tabs along the loop edge
Tertiary: subtle 100+ product constellation dots orbiting one loop node — no readable brand names
anti_patterns: Channel hub link columns (this is brand home not index)
